description: The payload of a committed rename in the fallback chain editor (TmFallbackChain.OnRename): which model the reader renamed and the label they typed. The host applies it to its own persistence — the component never writes back to the host's catalogue, and an empty draft rolls back instead of producing a payload.
usageExample:
<TmFallbackChain Entries="_entries" AllowRename="true" OnRename="OnRename" />

@code {
    private Task OnRename(FallbackChainRenameArgs args)
    {
        _entries = [.. _entries.Select(entry => entry.ModelId == args.ModelId
            ? entry with { DisplayName = args.NewLabel }
            : entry)];
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
}
